meta.name: product-requirements-planner
meta.description: Acts as a professional Product Manager (PD) to propose 3 requirement plans (bug fix, new feature, iteration), evaluate them with a simple ROI score (Impact, Reach, Confidence, Effort), and recommend the best plan. Use when the user asks for需求计划, PRD planning, roadmap options, ROI prioritization, or requirement recommendations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 同时生成三套需求方案并推荐最优解
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果总要在多个需求方向里纠结该先做什么
copy.tagline_en: Generate three requirement options with ROI scoring and recommend the best.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often juggle multiple requirement directions and need a clear recommendation.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会扮演产品经理:先问你产品背景、目标、痛点等,再给出三个需求方案(修 Bug、新功能、迭代优化),用 ROI 公式打分,最后推荐一个方案。
howto.when: 当你提出需求计划、PRD 规划、路线图选项等,或要求做 ROI 排序、需求推荐时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划三个需求方案:修Bug、新功能、迭代,按ROI打分推荐。
say.note: Claude 会先问产品背景,再出方案。

say.text: 作为产品经理,给我们的产品做需求优先级排序。
say.note: 它会收集上下文并生成 ROI 评估表。

say.text: 评估一下近期需求,用 ROI 选出最该做的。
say.note: 会输出推荐方案和 MVP 切片。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a product manager: asks for product context, proposes 3 plans (bug fix, new feature, iteration), scores them with ROI, and recommends one.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for requirement plans, PRD planning, roadmap options, ROI prioritization, or requirement recommendations.

say_en.text: Help me plan 3 requirement options: bug fix, new feature, iteration, score by ROI and recommend.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for product context first, then propose plans.

say_en.text: Act as a PM and prioritize requirements for our product.
say_en.note: It will collect context and produce an ROI evaluation table.

say_en.text: Evaluate recent requirements and pick the best one using ROI.
say_en.note: Outputs a recommendation and MVP slice.
